versions.content: FOTA Master ECU triggered Rollback Type: draft Description: The FOTA Target ECU shall be able to receive and execute a rollback instruction received by the Dcm. Rationale: In case of errors during the update of one or more ECUs within one update campaign a central instance needs to trigger a rollback of the whole update campaign on all affected ECUs. Note: The explicit rollback is triggered by the FOTA Master ECU. Dependencies: Use Case: An update campaign is executed but causes errors on several affected ECUS, which requires a rollback of all those ECUs. Supporting Material:
